name: سنوزر انمي
audience: Egyptian Arabic-speaking anime fans who enjoy romantic and comic story recaps with clear character continuity
dialect: Conversational Egyptian Arabic with natural comic timing
tone: Warm, lively, playful and character-led; jokes should clarify emotion or reversal rather than bury the plot
style: Original anime-inspired editorial panels with consistent character sheets, readable silhouettes and expressions, warm cinematic color, deliberate reaction close-ups, and a strong distinction between setup, reversal and payoff. Compose stills for purposeful cuts and occasional local layer reveals; add speech and labels only in the local compositor. Avoid screenshot imitation, drifting faces or outfits, generic speed lines, and a camera move on every image.
visual_directives: Illustrate expressive anime editorial panels featuring crisp 2D lineart, vibrant cel-shading, and clean silhouette readability.
Anchor characters with strict physical model invariants across sequential shots: lock exact hair color and parted silhouette, eye iris tint, and signature costume color blocking.
Stage comic storytelling through clear panel beats: wide establishing setup, mid-shot comedic complication, and dynamic reaction close-ups for emotional payoff.
Use warm cinematic studio lighting with purposeful contrast to emphasize character expression without muddling lineart or introducing washed-out tones.
Preserve active narrative context and environmental density in backgrounds; never neutralize scenes into sterile blank voids or featureless props.
Isolate graphic typography: leave all dialogue balloons, comic thought bubbles, onomatopoeia sound effects, and subtitle banners to the local post-production compositor.
Compose widescreen 16:9 panels with subjects centered in the middle 80% safe area, allowing 10% edge padding for dynamic Ken Burns pan-and-scan pacing.
